author: Unknown
title: DEM Party: We will continue our struggle to build the law of the future
content:
Debate on the bill titled “Strengthening National Solidarity and Social Integration,” submitted to the Parliamentary Justice Commission, has concluded. The commission adopted the bill. Representatives of political parties continued to take the floor on Article 9 of the 12-article bill.


DEM Party Justice Commission members Zülküf Uçar, Onur Düşünmez and Newroz Uysal Aslan also spoke about the provisions of the law.


Zülküf Uçar said the bill represented, for them, a historic window in which the Kurdish people’s struggle for existence and the state’s need for transformation intersected, and continued: “We consider this window to be a rich space in favour of democracy and freedoms. What matters now is to cultivate this space through a common will and put it on track towards a common future. In this sense, each of us has assumed an important responsibility. This law should be regarded as a law of commitment. It is a text that commits to Turkey’s democratic future. It is a text that commits to bringing the Kurdish people, with all their existence and rights, within the framework of the law. This text is the first step on the ladder leading towards the rule of law, freedom of expression and the vision of a democratic society.


As a requirement of the rational and natural dynamics of the search for integration, exceptional provisions should be removed from the text, and the text should be revised to encompass everyone. During this dynamic period in history, when major responsibilities have been assumed, continuous legislative activity until a final solution is reached should be the defining characteristic of the process. The laws that follow will be the lifeblood of this strategic process. Immediately after the first step being built today, we need to take the step towards the second.


“Resolving all these problems is the moral and legal responsibility of each and every one of us. As we know, in human creations, perfection is an ideal that can never be fully attained. Of course, this law is not perfect either, but it is historic. As a requirement of its historic character, we can address some of its shortcomings right here. First of all, we need to make the ambiguous content of Article 3 more explicit. We can begin by clarifying the scope of the phrase ‘the offence of intentional killing committed within the framework of organisational activities’ currently contained in the article. Because, as is known, when general principles of criminal law are applied to the elements of an offence, they become part of it, and this may lead to serious differences of interpretation in practice.


“Another issue concerns confiscation. Resorting to confiscation during the investigation and prosecution stages would constitute a serious violation of the presumption of innocence. For this reason, removing confiscation from the scope of this article is important for the legality and consistency of the law. Moreover, defining assets subject to confiscation through broadly interpretable concepts such as ‘goods and assets’ is not compatible with the general spirit of the law. This shortcoming also needs to be addressed.


Another issue that needs to be revised in the text of the article is contained in the third paragraph. Investigations concerning offences committed before the publication of the National Security Council decision but initiated after its publication are made subject to the board’s permission. However, when the six-month application period is taken into account, it becomes clear that this creates significant risks in practice. An investigation opened with the board’s permission after the six-month period has expired will not have any guarantee under this law. This problem, which is incompatible with the principle of the rule of law, must also be resolved. Our proposal regarding this paragraph is for the period stipulated in Article 9 to begin from the date on which the matter becomes known. If we address these shortcomings, we will have brought the law into a form consistent with its purpose and spirit.”


The law is a beginning


“This law is a beginning,” Onur Düşünmez said, adding: “The value of the step taken today lies in the fact that it opens the way for the steps that will follow. Everyone here, regardless of their political views, must approach such an issue, where the fate of peoples is at stake, with common sense. This issue goes far beyond short-term political calculations, narrow party interests and the reflex of …

author: Unknown
title: Tamir: Prisons have become centres of rights violations
content:
As concerns over the right to life of seriously ill prisoners in prisons grow by the day, the government’s failure to take concrete steps in this regard despite urgent calls for their release from lawyers, human rights defenders and civil society organisations has drawn criticism. The release of many sick prisoners whose treatment cannot be adequately maintained under prison conditions is being prevented through various administrative and political practices, despite the absence of any provision in execution legislation that would prevent their release.


In particular, reports by the Forensic Medicine Institute and decisions by the Administrative and Monitoring Boards, as well as assessments that prisoners “pose a risk to public security” or “are capable of maintaining their lives independently in prison,” are cited among the main obstacles preventing seriously ill prisoners from regaining their freedom.


Ahmet Tamir, who was released from prison after 30 years of incarceration, spoke to our agency about rights violations in prisons and the situation of sick prisoners.


A system targeting human dignity is in place


Tamir said prisons have been turned into places where severe rights violations occur, adding that “practices in prisons are compatible neither with international human rights standards nor with Turkey’s own laws. An entirely arbitrary approach to governance prevails. Everyone puts themselves in the place of the prosecutor, judge and decision-making authority. Even the most basic human right, the right to speak your mother tongue, is prohibited. You are prevented even from living according to your identity. You are openly subjected to the mentality that says, ‘If you submit, everything is permitted; if you don’t, you cannot even access your most basic needs.’ The prosecutor approves the prison’s decision, and the court then finds the prosecutor’s decision to be correct. In this way, rights violations become institutionalised. This is no longer simply a matter of violating the law; it is a system that targets human dignity.”


Ill prisoners are deliberately deprived of treatment


Pointing out that sick prisoners face the most severe conditions in prisons, Tamir said that deliberate delays are imposed even in urgent medical situations. He said that even in emergencies, calling an ambulance is delayed on various pretexts, adding: “They waste hours asking questions such as where the patient is in pain and which medication they are taking. Yet instead of providing urgent medical intervention, they deliberately waste time so that the illness becomes more severe. This is a deliberate practice. Prisoners referred to hospital are subjected to demands that they be examined while handcuffed. This effectively eliminates their right to receive treatment; they are told, ‘Either you will be examined in handcuffs or you will not be treated.’”


The aim is not to treat, but to slowly wear a person down


Tamir said that the policies implemented in prisons target not only physical but also psychological destruction, and continued: “Rather than abandoning a person directly to death, they try to consume them drop by drop. They aim to destroy their freedom of thought, will and hope. This is an inhumane mentality. The Forensic Medicine Institute says someone is ‘unfit’, while another doctor says they are ‘fit’. The hospital makes one decision, the prison administration makes another. It is unclear which decision is valid. Because everyone sees themselves as the sole authority. The mentality of ‘I am the power here, my decision is the one that counts’ prevails. Even prisoners in serious health conditions are given reports stating that they ‘can maintain their lives in prison’. This approach violates human dignity.


In particular, the Administrative and Monitoring Boards postpone the release of prisoners who have completed their sentences on various grounds. A prisoner whose sentence has ended can be given a three- or six-month postponement of release by being told, ‘You have consumed too much water.’ Yet water is already provided in limited quantities in prisons. These grounds cannot be explained in legal terms. The real aim is to undermine a person’s morale, destroy their hope and break their will. Practices that are an extension of special warfare policies are in operation in prisons. You are forced to use certain terms. If you use the expressions they want, they issue a report saying that you have been ‘rehabilitated’ …

author: Publicación Abierta
title: Las cunetas que España se niega a vaciar
content:
Casi seis mil. Esa es la cifra de fosas comunes e irregularidades documentadas de la Guerra Civil y la dictadura franquista repartidas por todo el territorio del Estado español. Entre 114.000 y 130.000 personas desaparecidas de forma forzosa siguen sin nombre, sin ataúd, sin lápida, bajo cunetas, pozos mineros y simas donde el fascismo las arrojó como quien tira basura. Es casi imposible caminar más de cincuenta kilómetros por este país sin pisar, sin saberlo, la tierra que cubre a un fusilado. Eso no es una metáfora poética: es geografía criminal.


En veinticinco años se han exhumado unas 17.000 víctimas. Quedan, como mínimo, 12.000 cuerpos por recuperar. Pico Reja, en el cementerio de San Fernando, en Sevilla, se ha convertido en una de las mayores fosas de la represión de toda Europa. Y mientras tanto, en el Valle de Cuelgamuros —el antiguo Valle de los Caídos—, se concentraron los restos de más de 500 fosas de ambos bandos, mezclados sin consentimiento de las familias, como último acto de expolio de un régimen que hasta en la muerte quiso seguir mandando sobre los cuerpos del pueblo.


Detrás de cada número hay un testimonio como el de Lucía Alcaide Quiroz, que recogí en *Fragmentos de rebelión*. Una mujer que con diecinueve años vio cómo la Guardia Mora entraba en su pueblo para degollar, violar y sembrar el terror, mientras mandos del ejército y jefes falangistas contemplaban la matanza como quien disfruta de un espectáculo taurino, y el propio cura del pueblo, que días antes daba la comunión a los que luego serían asesinados, sonreía ante el crimen. No lo cuento para escandalizar: lo cuento porque olvidarlo es la primera victoria que le regalamos al franquismo cada día que pasa.


Porque no hubo guerra, hubo golpe de Estado. Un golpe cobarde de militares traidores contra un gobierno legítimo, salido de las urnas, refrendado por la voluntad del pueblo. Y ese golpe, camaradas, no lo ganó Franco: lo ganaron Hitler y Mussolini, que además lo despreciaban. El propio Hitler llegó a decir que sin el primer avión Junker que le envió, Franco jamás habría sobrevivido, y se burlaba de que el dictador atribuyera su victoria a la intervención divina cuando en realidad fue la aviación alemana la que decidió la contienda desde el cielo. Mussolini fue todavía más directo: para él, Franco era sencillamente un idiota. Ni siquiera sus padrinos fascistas lo respetaban. Era un instrumento, un títere del nacionalcatolicismo más rancio, útil para machacar a la clase trabajadora española y nada más.


Siendo concejal en Narón recordé en el Pleno del Ayuntamiento a la bestia fascista también pasó. Tenemos documentados 93 asesinados: marineros fieles a la República fusilados y enterrados en el Val —cuarenta y ocho del acorazado España y del vapor Domine—, diecisiete más del Mar Cantábrico fusilados en San Mateo. Vecinos paseados en las cunetas, apaleados hasta la muerte, muertos en prisión. Y como anécdota que resume el nacionalcatolicismo hasta la náusea: el 26 de diciembre, para celebrar la Navidad, fusilaron a más de veinte marineros del España. Esa es la moral de quienes decían luchar por Dios y por España.


Noventa años después, el fascismo no ha muerto: se disfrazó. Aquí nunca fue derrotado como en Alemania o Italia, murió en la cama, con honores de Estado, y sus herederos siguen teniendo fundación propia, sillón en el Congreso y bendición mediática. Mientras la Fundación Francisco Franco exalta impunemente al genocida, se persigue a quien saca una bandera republicana. Esas son las prioridades reales de este régimen del 78.


Por eso hace falta memoria, justicia y reparación. Por eso hace falta abrir todas las fosas que quedan cerradas, y por eso, camaradas, hace falta seguir reclamando la III República. No como nostalgia, sino como proyecto de futuro para un pueblo que todavía no ha enterrado a sus muertos como se merecen.


 


Honor y gloria a nuestros mártires.


 


–


André Abeledo Fernández

Las cunetas que España se niega a vaciar

Indymedia Argentina Centro de Medios Independientes (( i ))

author: Ricardo Viel
title: Nada é fácil, por que ler seria?
content:
Por estes dias, discute-se em Portugal a possibilidade de que ler José Saramago deixe de ser obrigatório para os alunos do ensino médio no país. Ficaria a critério dos professores/escolas a inclusão de uma obra do Prêmio Nobel no plano de ensino. Entre os argumentos de quem defende a alteração está o fato de que os livros do autor de

Ensaio sobre a Cegueira


não são fáceis

.


Recentemente uma popular

influencer

 gravou um vídeo para contar aos seus milhares de seguidores que tinha comprado um livro pela capa e, ao chegar em casa, levou um susto com a quantidade de páginas que a obra continha. “Eu me conheço, não vai dar (para ler)”, desabafou a moça.


Semanas antes, outra

influencer

 reconheceu

usar a inteligência artificial

 para escrever os textos que publica num importante jornal. Em sua defesa, disse que as “ideias” são suas, o que a IA faz é “estruturar o seu pensamento” em forma de palavras. A colunista, que também é uma bem-sucedida empresária do ramo da beleza, explicou que dessa forma ganha tempo, já que é uma pessoa muito ocupada.


É uma queixa recorrente: falta-nos tempo, energia e paciência para ler (e, em alguns casos, também para escrever). É curioso que, para muitas outras coisas, esse discurso não vale. O que mais se vê por aí são os tais

coaches

pregando a necessidade do esforço e da perseverança para se alcançar objetivos. O pessoal que levanta roda de caminhão na academia, segue dieta restrita e passa por procedimentos estéticos, fala com orgulho do sacrifício que faz em busca do corpo que almeja. É comum ouvir nas igrejas e no ambiente corporativo o elogio ao martírio e à privação.


Então eu pergunto: por que quando o assunto é a literatura esse papo não cola? Por que não dizemos a verdade: ler é uma atividade que requer esforço, concentração e dedicação. Para sermos capazes de ler textos mais complexos, com certa profundidade, inevitavelmente teremos que antes ter lido muito, empenhado bastante tempo e paciência nessa tarefa.


E daí, qual o problema? Não há coisas extremamente difíceis que fazemos diariamente? Ou alguém acha que cozinhar é fácil? Há pratos que são complexos e trabalhosos de se fazer e nem por isso deixamos de prepará-los. E dirigir, é fácil? São necessários anos de prática até que alguém dirija realmente bem um veículo e muitas vezes acontecem acidentes pelo caminho. Poderia elencar muitas outras tarefas difíceis que realizamos com frequências, mas acho que já ficou claro o meu ponto de vista.


Vi há pouco tempo um estudo que comparava romances publicados há várias décadas com obras atuais. A conclusão era que, em média, um livro hoje contém bem menos palavras do que no passado. Não falo da extensão do texto, mas do repertório. Não da quantidade, senão da variedade. Tenho a impressão que isso não acontece só no universo literário, que estamos cada vez mais pobres no uso da língua e, por consequência, na transmissão das ideias. Parece óbvio: se conhecemos menos palavras, temos mais dificuldade em nos expressar e em entender o outro.


Há uns meses assisti a uma das aulas que o poeta José Luís Barreto Guimarães ministra na Faculdade de Medicina da Universidade do Porto. Ele, que também é médico, ensina poesia aos futuros colegas de profissão. “O médico que só sabe de medicina, nem de medicina sabe”, lê-se numa placa na entrada do edifício onde acontecem as aulas. O autor da frase é o médico, pesquisador e pintor Abel Salazar, que também foi professor daquela universidade e opositor político à ditadura em Portugal no século passado. A direção da faculdade confia que ao aprenderem a decifrar poemas os estudantes adquirem mais ferramentas para entender as queixas dos futuros pacientes. Graças às aulas de poesia, serão melhores profissionais e – isto digo eu – melhores pessoas.

author: BILD
title: Behörde kuscht vor linksextremen Hausbewohnern
content:
Illegale Pflanzkübel statt Parkplätze


Berlin –

Sie zimmern Holzgestelle, stellen sie einfach auf die Straße – und das Bezirksamt findet das auch noch gut. Die Bewohner der linksautonomen Rigaer Straße 94 in Berlin-Friedrichshain haben Parkplätze mit selbst gebauten Pflanzenkübeln blockiert. Statt einzuschreiten, lobt das grün geführte Bezirksamt die Aktion als „Initiativbepflanzung“.


Seit Jahrzehnten halten die Bewohner des besetzten Hauses die Behörden in Atem. Sie legten illegale Tunnel an, verbarrikadierten sich, bewarfen Streifenwagen mit Steinen und zündeten regelmäßig Barrikaden an. Immer wieder kommt es in der Rigaer Straße zu Polizeieinsätzen.


Ermittler vermuten Täter im Haus


Laut „WELT“ (gehört wie BILD zu Axel Springer) sind sich Ermittler sicher: Einige der Täter der Anschläge auf die Berliner Stromversorgung im September 2025 und im Januar dieses Jahres hielten sich regelmäßig in dem Haus auf.


Jetzt stehen vor dem besetzten Haus plötzlich Pflanzenkübel aus Holzpaletten. Die neueste Provokation wirkt auf den ersten Blick harmlos – aber die Kübel blockieren Parkplätze auf der Fahrbahn. Nach BILD-Informationen hatten die Hausbewohner zuvor immer wieder Ärger mit einer Firma gesucht, die dort regelmäßig ihre Transporter parkte.


Bezirksamt will nur Warntafeln anbringen


Die Polizei sah wegen des brennbaren Materials der Kübel eine mögliche Gefahrenquelle und wandte sich an das Berliner Bezirksamt. Denn für solche illegalen Ansammlungen ist das Ordnungsamt zuständig. Doch die von den Grünen geführte Behörde geht die Sache ruhig an. „Das Bezirksamt ist der Auffassung, dass zur Gefahrenabwehr vorerst das Anbringen von Warntafeln an den Gefäßen erforderlich ist, damit diese ausreichend erkennbar sind“, so ein Sprecher. Unklar sei, wer die Kübel überhaupt aufgestellt habe.


Mitarbeiter fürchten Widerstand der Bewohner


BILD liegt jedoch der interne E-Mail-Verkehr aus dem Bezirksamt vor. Darin fordert ein Mitarbeiter zunächst seine Kollegen auf: „Wir müssen handeln.“


Seine Mitarbeiterin wiegelt ab: Eine Firma würde die Pflanzkübel „nur unter Polizeischutz abbauen, da hier Widerstand der Bewohner befürchtet wird“. Gleichzeitig räumt sie ein, dass die Kübel „illegal aufgestellt wurden und auch eine gewisse Gefahr für die Verkehrssicherheit darstellen“. Weiter heißt es im E-Mail-Verlauf: „Aufgrund der politischen Dimension, bitte ich dich um Entscheidung, ob wir die Polizei dazu um Amtshilfe bitten sollen.“ Die Kollegin warnt sogar: „Im Fall von Verkehrsunfällen (…) wären wir vermutlich haftbar.“


Die Begründung aus dem Amt


Ein Mitarbeiter aus der „Fachbereichsleitung Straßen“ schlägt schließlich vor, Warntafeln anzubringen, „da eine Amtshilfe für einen Polizeischutz für die Beseitigung der Pflanzgefäße offenbar nicht angefordert werden soll“.


Es folgt eine Begründung, die wie ein Kuschen vor den linksextremen Hausbewohnern wirkt: „Die Gefäße vermitteln den Eindruck einer Initiativbepflanzung, was ja anderenorts durchaus gefördert wird.“


Initiativbepflanzung? BILD fragte noch einmal bei der Pressestelle des Bezirksamts nach. Sollen die Kübel wirklich bleiben? „Da das Bezirksamt weder den Bau der Beete noch deren Bepflanzung vorgenommen hat, können wir keine Angaben zur Motivation oder zur Bezeichnung machen“, so die offizielle Antwort. Die Pflanzgefäße stellen laut Bezirk allerdings „eine ungenehmigte Sondernutzung öffentlichen Straßenlandes dar“. ABER: „Nach Aussage einer angefragten Firma werden sämtliche Arbeiten im unmittelbaren Bereich Rigaer Straße 94 nur noch unter Polizeischutz ausgeführt.“ Heißt: Alles bleibt erst mal so, wie es ist.


CDU: „Wo leben wir denn?“


„Das ist doch unfassbar“, sagt die Bezirksverordnete Marita Fabeck (39, CDU). „Es entsteht der Eindruck, dass in Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg jeder machen kann, was er will – solange es in die grüne Agenda passt.“ Die Politikerin wirft dem Bezirksamt vor, die linksextremen Hausbesetzer mit Samthandschuhen anzufassen. Fabeck: „Wo leben wir denn, dass die einfach ihr Zeug auf die Straße stellen können und nichts passiert?“


Quelle: https://www.bild.de/regional/berlin/rigaer-strasse-berlin-behoerde-kuscht-vor-linksextremen-hausbewohnern-6a71a5b7cc46967c04cae391

author: Rheinmetall Entwaffnen Berlin
title: Montag, 17. August 2026 * 18:30 Uhr Onboarding für Neue * 19:00 Uhr Plenum * NewYorck Bethanien * Berlin-Kreuzberg
content:
Bei unserem Treffen am 17. August werden wir zunächst Organisatorisches für die kommenden Wochen und insbesondere für das Protestcamp in Köln, das vom 01. – 06.09.2026 stattfindet, besprechen.


Nach dem Plenum ist geplant, sowohl für das Rheinmetall Entwaffnen Camp in Köln als auch in Hamburg plakatieren zu gehen.


Kommt dafür am Montag, den 17. August 2026 um 18:30 Uhr ins NewYorck Bethanien, Mariannenplatz 2a, 10999 Berlin-Kreuzberg, 2. Etage.


Oder schreibt uns eine E-Mail: rheinmetall-entwaffnen-berlin@riseup.net


Wer sind wir?


Seit 2018 organisiert Rheinmetall Entwaffnen regelmäßig kleine und große Aktionen gegen Aufrüstung, Abschottung, Waffenproduktion und Rüstungsexporte. Wir sind ein bundeseites Bündnis, das in vielen Städten lokal verankert ist. In Berlin kommen wir alle zwei Wochen zusammen. Wir diskutieren auf unseren Treffen aktuelle Entwicklungen, vernetzen uns mit anderen Aktivst:innen, planen Veranstaltungen, Aktionstage, Aktionswochen und natürlich auch Camps.


Unsere Motivation und unser gemeinsames Ziel ist es, der Aufrüstung und militärischen Zuspitzung durch aktives Handeln was entgegenzusetzen und im besten Fall zusammen aufzuhalten. Denn: Kriege nützen den Reichen, wir liefern die Leichen. Wir wollen den Kapitalismus überwinden, um die Ursachen und fatalen Folgen von Krieg und Elend abzuschaffen. Wir kämpfen für eine solidarische Welt, ohne Ausbeutung, Unterdrückung und Krieg.

title: Laïcité coloniale et lois d'exception en Afrique française
content:
Texte paru dans le numéro 1878 du magazine mensuel de la Fédération Anarchiste (

FA

) «

 

Le Monde Libertaire

 

» sur le 120

e

 anniversaire de la loi du 9 décembre 1905 concernant la séparation des Églises et de l'État.


Le 120

e

 anniversaire de la loi du 9 décembre 1905 concernant la séparation des Églises et de l'État nous permet de revenir sur une histoire jalonnée d'exceptions. Nous l'avons évoqué notamment avec l'historien Sadek Sellam que nous avons invité plusieurs fois durant notre émission «

 

Médias et antifascisme

 

» présente tous les deuxièmes vendredis du mois sur Radio Libertaire à 11h30. L'application à géométrie variable de la laïcité française nous montre ainsi que le culte musulman en Algérie et aux colonies fit l'objet d'un dirigisme troublant de la part de l'État.


L'émission «

 

Médias et antifascisme

 

» que nous animons sur Radio Libertaire tous les deuxièmes vendredis du mois à 11h30 depuis le 11 octobre 2024 s'est penché plusieurs fois sur des sujets liés à la laïcité. Avec l'historien Sadek Sellam, nous nous sommes employés à analyser les applications bancales de la loi du 9 décembre 1905 jusqu'à nos jours. Nous avons ainsi évoqué à partir du 14 mars 2025 la gestion en France du culte musulman notamment à travers le cas de la grande mosquée de Paris.


Cette institution inaugurée en 1926 met ainsi en valeur une gestion coloniale et dirigiste d'un culte considérée à la fois comme exotique et dangereux. La mosquée a en effet été inaugurée presque trois ans après la création par le conseil municipal de Paris d'une «

 

section d'affaires indigènes nord-africaines

 

». Le maréchal Hubert Lyautey à cette époque «

 

résident général de la République au Maroc

 

» avait ainsi été consulté pour un projet d'institut musulman imaginé initialement par le professeur Paul Bourdarie.


Ce dernier enseignait au collège libre des sciences sociales, dirigeait la revue «

 

Indigène

 

» et voulait mettre «

 

en contact les jeunes éléments les plus cultivés de l'islam avec la fleur de la science et de la société française

 

». Si la mosquée a pu voir le jour, le projet d'institut fut allègrement saboté par Lyautey qui craignait sa possible influence sur les «

 

jeunes musulmans

 

»

 [

1

]

. L'État versa tout de même à cet institut purement fictif des subventions jusqu'en décembre 1980. Une «

 

commission nationale des français musulmans

 

» présidée par le secrétaire d'État aux rapatriés Jacques Dominati venait en effet de montrer le non-fonctionnement de cet institut.


Un autre exemple du non-respect de la laïcité par le gouvernement fut la nomination de Hamza Boubakeur au poste de recteur de la mosquée de Paris le 18 mai 1957. Ce dernier était hostile à l'indépendance de l'Algérie et faisait selon le chef du gouvernement Guy Mollet mieux l'affaire qu'Ahmed Benghabrit.


Celui-ci avait succédé à son oncle Kaddour qui dirigeait la mosquée depuis sa création. Il fut ainsi «

 

limogé

 

» pour avoir refusé de coopérer avec le commissariat de police du cinquième arrondissement de Paris où se situe la mosquée. Son refus de lutter contre le Front de Libération Nationale (

FLN

) algérien et sa dénonciation de la torture poussa Mollet à nommer à sa place un homme aux ambitions politiques bien trempées.


Boubakeur cherchait en effet à partir de 1960 à devenir le président d'une République saharienne qui aurait été issue de la séparation du Sahara du reste de l'Algérie. Ce plan de participation soutenu par le premier ministre français Michel Debré tomba finalement à l'eau. La nomination de Boubakeur à la tête de la mosquée de Paris fut elle condamnée en 1963 par le tribunal administratif de Paris. Cela n'empêcha pas Boubakeur de rester à son poste jusqu'en 1982 avant que l'Algérie ne prenne le relais de la France dans le versement de subventions à la mosquée de Paris

 [

2

]

.


La laïcité inexistante en Algérie et en Afrique Occidentale Française


L'article 43 de la loi du 9 décembre 1905 concernant la séparation des Églises et de l'État stipule que «

 

des règlements d'administration publique détermineront les conditions dans lesquelles la présente loi sera applicable à l'Algérie et aux colonies

 

». L'article 11 alinéa 6 du décret du 27 septembre 1907 déterminant les conditions d'application en Algérie de la loi de 1905 affirme de son côté que le gouverneur général peut accorder des indemnités de fonction aux ministres qui exercent le culte public …

author: dev
title: Intelligence multiple contre polycrise entrepreneuriale
content:
Dans son discours de victoire, Abelardo de la Espriella a commis un lapsus en présentant son vice-président Juan Manuel Restrepo : il l'a qualifié de « nouveau président » de la Colombie, de manière d'ailleurs tant naturelle qu'il ne s'en est pas rendu compte lui-même. Lors d'autres interventions, de la Espriella a qualifié son vice-président de véritable moteur de la campagne ; et lors du second tour, il a limité ses apparitions publiques, laissant Restrepo prendre la parole dans une grande partie des interviews. Parallèlement, la campagne s'est attachée à discréditer la candidate d'Iván Cepeda à la vice-présidence, Aida Quilcué, en mobilisant une série de préjugés racistes à l'encontre des peuples autochtones. À partir d'une analyse des candidats à la vice-présidence d'Abelardo de la Espriella et d'Iván Cepeda, cet article présente les différentes conceptions de gouvernement, de la politique et du pouvoir qui se sont affrontées au cours de la dernière campagne électorale en Colombie, et permet d'entrevoir les implications de la victoire de de la Espriella ainsi que les points forts de l'opposition de gauche.


Le vice-président d'Abelardo de la Espriella, José Manuel Restrepo, est titulaire d'un doctorat ; il a été ministre des Finances et recteur d'université, et s'est présenté comme le cerveau du nouveau président colombien. Pendant la campagne électorale, Cepeda a présenté comme colistière Aida Quilcué, dirigeante autochtone du peuple Nasa et sénatrice de la République. Au cours de la campagne électorale, la droite a insisté pour qu'un débat ait lieu entre les deux candidats, estimant que la comparaison parlait d'elle-même. Elle avait raison, mais pas dans le sens où elle l'espérait. La comparaison parle effectivement d'elle-même, et ce qu'elle révèle, c'est que la droite continue de confondre les diplômes avec l'intelligence, et l'intelligence avec le pouvoir. Dans ce scénario, il suffit d'asseoir l'économiste face à une femme autochtone ne possédant pas les mêmes diplômes officiels pour que la simple comparaison des parcours certifiés fasse pencher la balance. Ils se trompent sur le fond. Et nous allons développer cet argument en utilisant les mêmes formes académiques qui les intéressent tant.


Ce qui est présenté comme un contraste de compétences est, en réalité, un stratagème de délégitimation. Premièrement, cela relève d'un sophisme d'autorité en supposant que le doctorat, le poste ou la fonction de recteur garantissent une supériorité politique. Deuxièmement, cela relève du « crédentialisme », réduisant la valeur du savoir à ce qu'une institution certifie. Troisièmement, on se trouve face à un sophisme de composition épistémologique, car l'argument considère que la maîtrise des connaissances économiques ou de l'administration publique équivaut à la compréhension de l'ensemble de la vie sociale, territoriale, historique et écologique. Et derrière tout cela se cache un biais plus profond, à savoir la vieille conviction selon laquelle l'intelligence n'appartient qu'à quelques-uns et que les autres doivent se contenter d'obéir ; c'est là que réside le véritable problème : il s'agit de deux conceptions opposées de l'intelligence et du pouvoir.


En 1995, avec la publication de

La mésentente

, le philosophe Jacques Rancière soutenait que la démocratie n'est pas le gouvernement naturel des plus compétents, mais l'interruption d'un ordre qu'il appelle la police, celui qui détermine d'avance qui compte et qui ne compte pas, qui peut parler et qui doit se taire. La technocratie est la forme la plus commode de cette logique policière, car elle présuppose et surveille les lieux légitimes de la parole, de l'expertise et de la décision, et s'interroge sur les titres comme si elle s'interrogeait sur le droit même d'exister politiquement. Mais la démocratie commence précisément lorsque cette répartition devient contestable.


Aida Quilcué a bouleversé cette répartition en proposant de construire une Colombie où la sagesse des peuples et des communautés participe activement à l'orientation des décisions collectives ; où le développement se mesure à l'aune de la dignité de la vie et non pas uniquement à celle des indicateurs économiques ; où la terre, la culture, l'éducation et la santé constituent les piliers de la justice sociale ; et où le dialogue et la diversité remplacent définitivement l'exclusion et la violence.


En ce sens, Quilcué ne s'est pas présenté à la campagne électorale comme une individualité isolée …

author: Unknown
title: Ephéméride des luttes : 8 août
content:
Aujourd'hui 8 août, la journée de l'éphéméride des luttes est rythmée au son des explosions, de poudre et de rage. Et c'est l'insurrection à Marseille, aussi, sachez-le. Souvenez-vous du camarade Gaston.


1870 :

 A

Marseille

, face à la situation désastreuse du pays, un mouvement insurrectionnel, avec à sa tête le radical Gaston Crémieux, tente en vain de proclamer la République et d'instaurer une Commune révolutionnaire. Mais le mouvement est rapidement maté et Crémieux est arrêté le lendemain et déféré devant un conseil de guerre. Il faudra attendre le 23 mars 1871 pour qu'une véritable Commune révolutionaire soit effective.


1879 :

 Naissance d'Emiliano Zapata, révolutionnaire mexicain.


1897 :

 Assassinat par l'anarchiste Michele Angiolillo du président du Conseil espagnol Antonio Cánovas del Castillo pour venger les condamnés du procès de Montjuïc du

4 mai

.


1924 :

 A Montevideo en Uruguay, parution du premier numéro du journal anarchiste "Ahora" ('Maintenant').


1927 :

 A Montevideo, une bombe de forte puissance explose dans le dépôt principal de la West Oil India Company, dans le cadre de la campagne de soutien aux anarchistes Italiens Sacco et Vanzetti, qui risquent la condamnation à mort aux Etats-Unis.


1963 :

 Au Royaume-Uni, une bande de quinze braqueurs attaque le train Londres-Glasgow et parvient à s'enfuir avec 2,6 millions de livres sterling en billets.


1969 :

 - En Italie, des bombes de faible puissance explosent dans huit trains différents. C'est le début de la stratégie de la tension orchestrée par les groupes néofascistes et les services secrets.


 Le même jour, les Beatles prennent leur fameuse photo d'Abbey Road.


1974 :

 Démission du président des Etats-Unis Richard Nixon suite au scandale du Watergate.


1977 :

 - A Montpellier, le groupe 'Les rescapés de Malville' attaque les locaux d'EDF à l'explosif :

« Tandis que les centrales nucléaires déversent quotidiennement leur poison mortel, à Malville le capital n'a pas hésité à recourir à l'assassinat et à l'emprisonnement pour désamorcer un mouvement de refus qui échappe de plus en plus au contrôle des partis. […] Si nous avons plastiqué EDF au moment où les syndicats s'élèvent contre les dégradations commises contre ce 'service public', c'est que pour nous EDF est le support idéologique et technique de l'État dans l'implantation des centrales nucléaires. Liberté pour tous les prisonniers »

.


Reproduit dans

La Canaille à Golfech

, mutines séditions, Paris, 2013, p.128-129.


 A Turin, des bâtons de dynamite sont jetés dans un commissariat de police par une fenêtre.

 A Lucca en Toscane, le groupe 'Lotta Armata per il Comunismo' fait sauter une puissante charge explosive contre les répétiteurs de TV, coupant le réseau de la région.


1981 :

 En Irlande du Nord, mort d'un neuvième gréviste de la faim de l'IRA, Thomas McElwee, après 62 jours. C'est aussi le dixième anniversaire des mesures d'internement total, ce qui provoque des émeutes dans plusieurs zones républicaines du pays. Trois personnes meurent au cours de ces affrontements.


1983 :

 A Moissac, dans le Tarn-et-Garonne, attaque contre l'entreprise Culetto qui perdra 25 camions, des bulldozers, des pelles mécaniques, une centrale mobile à béton et un hangar de 1200m², ainsi que contre la centrale à béton de Spie batignolles juste un peu plus loin. Le Mouvement AntiNucléaire (MAN) revendique les sabotages et offrira une interview au journal clandestin 'Toulouse la Canaille' pour expliquer un peu le pourquoi du comment.


1985 :

 A Francfort, attaque de la guérilla ouest-européenne contre une base américaine de l'US Air Force. Revendiquée par le commando 'George Jackson' d'un groupe mixte d'Action Directe et de la Fraction Armée Rouge. Deux soldats sont tués et plus d'un million de marks de dégâts sont commis.


1994 :

 A Crossgar en Irlande du Nord, l'IRA abat un officier des troupes royales irlandaises.


1998 :

 En Angleterre, le Front de Libération Animale (ALF) libère 10% des visons en captivité das le pays, c'est-à-dire 6000.


1999 :

 En Irlande du Nord, la Irish National Liberation Army (INLA) annonce le cessez-le-feu. C'est l'une des premières tendances de l'IRA à abandonner les armes.


Voir aussi

l'éphéméride anarchiste

 du 8 août, riche de biographies.

author: Corey Oakley
title: Victorian Socialists launch statewide election campaign
content:
The following is the text, edited for clarity, of a speech by Victorian Socialists secretary Corey Oakley at the party’s state election campaign launch on Saturday, 1 August. The launch, held at the Aborigines Advancement League in the Melbourne suburb of Thornbury, was attended by around 800 party members and supporters from across the state. The party’s state election platform,

A socialist manifesto for real change,

was released at the launch—with the initial print run of 500 selling out on the night.

In the last year the Australian political map—as people here will know—has been turned upside down by the rise of One Nation in the polls. First, we saw them smashing the Liberal Party vote. And if you believe the polls that have been coming out over the past few months, they're now starting to smash into the Labor Party vote as well.

The election in Victoria in November is the first major statewide test of how far this development is going to go. And the outcome, I think, will define the terrain of politics across this country for years to come. 

It’s going to have huge ramifications for the election that’s happening in New South Wales in March next year, and the next federal election [due by May 2028]. All of those will happen in the context of what happens here in Victoria this year.

Now, we know that every step forward for One Nation is a victory for hatred, a victory for racism and for vicious right-wing politics. And we know that every step forward they take pushes the Liberal Party further to the right, further to attack migrants, and pushes the lunatic right wing in the media to demand even more extreme reactionary measures.

But we also know that the Labor Party offer no alternative that can galvanise people against the far right. They are incapable of advancing a vision of how society can be changed for the better.

How could the Labor Party do that? Labor is the party of genocide. It is the party of neoliberalism and privatisation, the party of attacks on the poor and the vulnerable. And the new Labor leadership in Victoria, whose education minister refused to give teachers the deal that they deserve and desperately need, is only going to take Labor further to the right.

So we cannot accept that those are the only options. What is desperately needed, and what we plan to provide, is a radical alternative that stands against the right, but also throws to the curb any idea that Labor’s corporate centrism can deal with the crisis our society is currently in.

We need bold socialist politics that identify and combat the key problem: that our society is ruled by and for the super-rich. And we need politics that stand against the racism and scapegoating that are at the core of the One Nation threat. We need a party that provides a vision of hope and solidarity, and stands for a radical redistribution of wealth and power in this state and in this country.

So that is why we are embarking today on the biggest socialist campaign this country has ever seen.

When we first set up Victorian Socialists in 2018, we stood just in the northern suburbs of Melbourne. For the last election in 2022, we ran across the west as well as the north—22 [lower house] seats altogether. This time we are running in every single seat statewide.

We have already preselected candidates in 72 lower house seats. That includes every seat in metropolitan Melbourne and more from across the state. We already have candidates in seats in Geelong, Bendigo, Ballarat and elsewhere. By the end of this month, we will have finalised candidates in every one of the 88 seats across the state.

Every voter in Victoria will have a socialist option to vote for, in both the lower house and the upper house. That is something that has never happened before, either in this state or anywhere else in Australia.

Now, running a statewide campaign is going to be an enormous undertaking. Since 2022, we’ve put extensive effort into building up our infrastructure and building up local organisation everywhere that we can, and we plan to expand that rapidly in the coming months. There are approximately 6,000 polling booths across Victoria that we will need to staff on election day. To do that, we’ll need at least 4,000 volunteers.

The people in this room are a crucial part of how we’re going to make that happen, which I’ll come back to.

But while we are extremely excited to be running across the state, I want to make it clear that we have no intention of …

author: Unknown
title: Steffi - Polis- och arbetsgivareväldet i Ljusne
content:
Författare

: Steffi

Titel

: Polis- och arbetsgivareväldet i Ljusne

Undertitel

: Försök att förbjuda spridandet av revolutionär litteratur!

Källa

: Tidningen Brand #44 1916


 Söndagen den 14 okt 1916 var undertecknad nog »fräck» att utan Herren av Ljusne greve von Halvylle o. polismyndigheternas tillstånd sälja

Brand

, Syndikalisten och Nya Folkviljan på torget i Ljusne. Tidningsförsäljningen gick bra till fram emot middagstiden, då det framkom till mig en civilklädd polisman med skarpa ögon och ett korrekt utseende i sällskap med en dito fyrfoting. Med en stämma som han hade ett helt kompani soldater framför sig, röt han till: »vad säljer ni för tidningar?» Jag svarade, utan att låtsa se honom,

Brand

, Syndikalisten och Nya Folkviljan.


 Efter dispyt, så förstod ordningstöraren att intet var att hämta den dagen. Han avlägsnade sig efter sitt misslyckade försök att förbjuda Brandförsäljningen.


 Tack emellertid för agitationen herr konstapel, ty på kanppt en sekund var jag omringad av en del arbetare som voro glada att ännu en gång få läsa dessa våra tidningar. Ty alla som sålt någon av dessa tidningar har fått avsked. Sverge är ju frihetens stamort på jorden. Men polisen fick ej något mera tillfälle den dagen att intervjua mig.


 Men jag skall här med några ord upplysa konstapeln vad jag har för sysselsättning. På grund av konflikten med Ostkustbanan, har Lerviks L. S. utsett mig till

blockadvakt

 på 3:dje avd. för att tillse att ej någon med smutisga fingrar rör eller handskas med Ostkustbanebolagets maskiner och verktyg eller på något annat sätt uppträder som förrädare förr än nöjaktig uppgörelse träffats med samtliga Lokala Samorg. vid Ostkustbanan.


 Även får jag meddela Ljusne arbetare och andra intresserade att jag träffas på torget fredag och lördag för försäljning av

Brand,

 Syndikalisten och Nya Folkviljan.


 Fram för den revolutionära socialismen!

author: groundxero
title: ‘Not Fair NEET, But Ban NEET’: Hunger Strike Against NEET Enters Seventh Day in Chennai
content:
The indefinite hunger strike against the National Eligibility-cum-Entrance Test (NEET) in Chennai entered its seventh day on Saturday, August 8. The agitation, led by the Anti-NEET Federation and the Joint Movement Against NEET, is demanding not merely reforms to the examination but its complete abolition, along with greater state control over education.


 


Chennai, August 8, 2026:

 An indefinite hunger strike demanding the abolition of the National Eligibility-cum-Entrance Test (NEET) entered its seventh day in Chennai on Saturday, with four anti-NEET activists continuing their fast at Koyambedu.


 


The four hunger strikers —

Dhanasekar, Jeeva, Puliyanthope Mohan and Ravi

 — are associated with the Ban NEET Movement of the Anti-NEET Federation in Tamil Nadu. The Joint Movement Against NEET is demanding the abolition of NEET, greater state autonomy over education and a designated public space in Chennai where the protesters can continue their agitation peacefully. One of the four hunger-strikers, Ravi was hospitalised on Thursday after coughing up blood. His condition is now reported to be stable.


 


The protesters are demanding that the TVK-led Tamil Nadu government pass a fresh Assembly resolution or Bill seeking exemption from NEET and pursue the pending legal challenge concerning the state’s earlier attempt to secure an exemption. They have also called for the government to provide a permanent public venue for peaceful protests in Chennai.


 


“We will call off the hunger strike if a resolution is passed. That’s the first step. Then, we need an alternative location to carry on with our protest against the exam,” said

S Manirathinam

, brother of S Anitha, whose death in 2017 became a defining moment in Tamil Nadu’s opposition to NEET.


 


Manirathinam urged the Tamil Nadu government to reaffirm its opposition to NEET through a fresh Assembly resolution or Bill. He said previous AIADMK and DMK governments had passed resolutions and a Bill seeking an exemption and argued that a renewed initiative would demonstrate that opposition to NEET cuts across party lines.


 


He also called for the state government to expedite its legal challenge to the President’s decision to withhold assent to the earlier exemption Bill passed in the state assembly.


 


‘Not fair NEET, but ban NEET’


 


The Anti-NEET Federation, a collective of students’ and youth organisations and social workers, says its demand goes beyond seeking reforms that will make NEET more transparent or prevent examination malpractice.


 


Its position is unequivocal:

NEET itself should be abolished

.


 


The federation argues that NEET favours students who can afford expensive private coaching and additional years of preparation, placing students from rural, government-school and marginalised communities at a great disadvantage. The Joint Movement Against NEET has similarly argued that the examination has deepened inequalities in access to medical education and contributed to the expansion of the private coaching industry. Its press statement also cited nearly 40 student deaths in Tamil Nadu, including those of Anitha, Pratheeba and Anukreethika, which it linked to examination pressure, systemic inequalities and unequal access to opportunities.


 


The federation is also demanding that states be allowed greater freedom to determine medical admissions, including the use of Plus Two examination marks, and that education be moved from the Concurrent List back to the State List.


 


Dhanasekar said the hunger strike began after the protesters were denied permission to hold a peaceful public demonstration, despite an assurance reportedly given during earlier anti-NEET protests.


 


School Education Minister A Rajmohan visited the protest site on Wednesday, reiterated the government’s opposition to NEET and appealed to the protesters to withdraw their fast, Dhanasekar said. “We will end the hunger strike only if the government allots us a public place to continue our agitation peacefully,” he said.


 


Anitha’s name remains at the heart of the anti-NEET struggle


 


Do you remember S Anitha?


 


During the month-long protests against NEET at Delhi’s Jantar Mantar, her name was repeatedly invoked by protesters from Tamil Nadu. For the anti-NEET movement, her memory is not merely commemorative. It is political.


 


Anitha was a

Dalit student

from Ariyalur district and the daughter of an

 agricultural daily-wage labourer …

author: Nehaa Bimal
title: Nunavut cabinet minister’s wife dies after cancer battle
content:
Carol Akeeagok, the wife of Nunavut Education Minister David Akeeagok, has died after a battle with cancer.


Akeeagok announced her death in a Facebook post Friday, saying Carol died peacefully in the early hours of Aug. 7 surrounded by family.


“Carol brought so much joy to our lives and many others,” he said. “Thank you for your love and support during this difficult time.”


Akeeagok said funeral arrangements will be announced later.


Carol Akeeagok was diagnosed with stage 4 cancer, and the couple had been travelling south for her chemotherapy treatment since last December.


David Akeeagok, who is the MLA for Iqaluit-Niaqunnguu, was absent from the Nunavut legislative assembly for much of that time while supporting his wife. He returned to the assembly in June and thanked colleagues and others for their support.


During a June 9 member’s statement, Akeeagok said his wife was strong despite the challenges of her treatment.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Media sanción al proyecto de “propiedad privada” pero sin los cambios en la Ley de Manejo del Fuego
content:
El gobierno logró la media sanción del proyecto de Ley de “inviolabilidad de la propiedad privada” pero debió retirar también los cambios a la Ley de Manejo del Fuego. Fue cerca de la 1 y media de la mañana por 37 votos a favor y 33 del en contra, luego de una sesión de casi 12 horas que se realizó en medio de la represión a la marcha pacífica que se realizó frente al Congreso.


El oficialismo ya había tenido que dejar atrás el capitulo que facilitaba la acumulación de tierras en manos extranjeras, y antes de la votación también retiró el que eliminaba los límites a la venta y cambio de uso de tierras incendiadas en zonas de bosque nativo y áreas protegidas. Sí se aprobaron las limitaciones a las expropiaciones que puede hacer el Estado y la agilización de desalojos.


La senadora neuquina de

La Libertad Avanza Nadia Márquez

, reconoció que uno de los objetivos es poder desalojar por ejemplo a comunidades mapuches en su provincia:

 “Una señora a quien no conozco se llama

María Boers

, argentina, no es Mary, es María, es argentina, no es extranjera, adquirió alrededor de 600 hectáreas cerca de

Villa Langostura

. Llamativamente en el año 2012, 2011 perdón, le usurpan parte de su territorio, parte de sus hectáreas, grupos autodenominados mapuches. Ya hace 15 años que esta mujer


de casi 70 años, hace 15 años que no puede tener su propiedad privada”.


Con respecto a los límites que se ponen a las expropiaciones que puede hacer el estado el senador de

Unión por la Patria Mariano Recalde,

se busca que no se puedan recuperar las tierras y empresas que este gobierno venda:

My name is Arianna, and I’m reaching out for help during a really difficult time. I recently lost my job because I said “Free Palestine.” I want to be clear that I wasn’t antagonizing anyone. author: Mosha Folger
title: Cambridge Bay giveaway is no small potatoes
content:
The Hamlet of Cambridge Bay’s health living department has been busy distributing 1,500 pounds (681 kilograms) of potatoes to residents and organizations in the community since Wednesday.


Fred Muise, programs manager for the wellness centre in Cambridge Bay, said in an email that the potatoes were going fast and that a majority were gone by Thursday evening.


“We received over 1,500 pounds of potatoes, and the next morning, about half of them were gone. And when I checked later that night, about 75 per cent of them were gone,” Muise said in an email to Nunatsiaq News.


The potatoes came from Miner Farms in Saskatchewan and were shipped north by a Grand Prairie, Alta. non-profit called the Polaris Pantry Project, run by Kristi and Martin Fujita. They started the non-profit after six years of shopping and shipping to northern communities with their company GP2U.


“Polaris Pantry is only in its second year of operation,” Kristi Fujita said in an interview. “It’s a certified non-profit.…  We were kind of doing this off the side of our desks… but then we thought we should do this properly. If we registered as a non-profit, we could get more donations for people.”


Fujita said they received about 16,000 pounds of potatoes, and have sent them to the Yukon, the Northwest Territories, and multiple communities in Nunavut, including Grise Fiord and Arctic Bay. Fujita says the federal government’s Nutrition North food subsidy program covered the cost of shipping.


“There’s no cost,” Fujita said. “All that Fred’s team had to do was go pick it up.”


What Muise and his team picked up was a pallet carrying a large bag with the potatoes.


Retailers in Cambridge Bay could not be reached for pricing of potatoes in the community but in Iqaluit, where prices tend to be lower, a store was selling equivalent potatoes for more than $22 for a 10-pound bag.


Muise said that along with Cambridge Bay residents getting potatoes, he notified both the men’s and women’s shelters that the vegetables were available for free. He confirmed the elders’ facility had picked potatoes up for its kitchen. Muise said he had not encountered any problems with the distribution of the potatoes, despite one commenter on the Facebook post that announced the potato availability saying he saw a possible health violation.


“I didn’t see any issues at all with distribution,” Muise said. “I noticed family members helping elders and those who didn’t drive, I also saw friends reaching out to their friends saying, let’s go get some potatoes, and they did.”


The potatoes were available for pickup behind Cambridge Bay’s old wellness centre, and if there are still spuds there Muise says residents should bring their own bag and bring some home.


“I love how everyone came together as a community to support each other,” Muise said. “From the farmers, the Polaris Pantry Project, Buffalo Airways, the Department of Healthy Living, and especially our community for coming together and supporting each other in order to help fight food insecurity.”

author: Publicación Abierta
title: A Cuba no permiten pasar ni las jeringuillas: el bloqueo genocida se ceba ahora con la ayuda humanitaria
content:
Hay que decirlo con toda la claridad de la que seamos capaces, camaradas: cuando un imperio impide que lleguen jeringuillas a un hospital, cuando impide que lleguen alimentos y medicinas a un pueblo, ese imperio ha dejado de disfrazar su crueldad. La ha desnudado.


Acaba de conocerse que decenas de contenedores con ayuda humanitaria destinada a Cuba permanecen retenidos en puertos del Caribe. Entre los casos denunciados hay dos cargamentos salidos desde Cataluña y Madrid: uno con bienes de primera necesidad, otro con tres millones y medio de jeringuillas destinadas a Santiago de Cuba. Ambos bloqueados no por un tribunal, no por una ley aprobada democráticamente en ningún parlamento del mundo, sino por el miedo de las navieras a las represalias de Washington. Ese es el verdadero rostro del bloqueo: ni siquiera hace falta que EEUU mueva un dedo directamente, basta con que el terror extraterritorial de sus sanciones paralice a empresas privadas de medio mundo para que la solidaridad quede secuestrada en un muelle.


Y no es un caso aislado, camaradas. Las organizaciones que lo denuncian son claras: miles de contenedores con medicamentos, alimentos y suministros esenciales siguen varados en la región. Miles. Mientras tanto, en los hospitales cubanos, las listas de espera quirúrgica se acumulan, la mortalidad infantil crece, y una jeringuilla —una simple jeringuilla, camaradas, el objeto más humilde y elemental de toda la medicina— se convierte en munición de guerra económica retenida en un contenedor por miedo a una sanción del Tesoro estadounidense.


Que quede grabado a fuego: no es la ineficiencia del socialismo cubano lo que impide que esa ayuda llegue a Santiago de Cuba. Es el imperialismo yanqui, con su maquinaria extraterritorial de sanciones, extorsionando a navieras europeas para que ni siquiera se atrevan a transportar jeringuillas. Ese es el nivel de sadismo al que ha llegado el bloqueo bajo la administración Trump: ya no basta con asfixiar el comercio directo con la isla, ahora se extiende el brazo del imperio para impedir que ni la caridad más elemental llegue a su destino.


Gracias, Cuba socialista, por tu ejemplo de solidaridad y resistencia. Apoyo a Cuba socialista y al pueblo cubano, a la decisión firme de un pueblo valiente que se negó, hace más de sesenta años, a volver a ser el patio trasero de Estados Unidos, ni su casino, ni su prostíbulo. Admiro la heroica resistencia de un pueblo sometido al bloqueo más brutal e ilegal de la historia contemporánea, un bloqueo que pisotea año tras año todas las resoluciones de los organismos internacionales, y que solo cuenta con la complicidad de un régimen: el genocida Estado de Israel.


Aplaudo la defensa que hace el pueblo cubano de su soberanía, pero también su ejemplo internacionalista y solidario para con los pueblos del mundo. Ahí está su papel imprescindible en la derrota del apartheid en Angola, una victoria que arrastró consigo la independencia de Namibia y aceleró el fin del propio apartheid sudafricano. Ahí están sus incontables brigadas médicas, salvando vidas en este mismo instante en rincones del planeta que el capitalismo occidental decidió abandonar a su suerte.


Fidel Castro fue, en efecto, un tremendo dictador: el dictador que resistió al imperio más armado y agresivo que ha conocido la humanidad con el único respaldo de su pueblo; el dictador que invadió el Tercer Mundo con médicos y no con soldados; el dictador que abrió sus universidades a los pueblos oprimidos del planeta, y ahí están los médicos saharauis para dar fe de ello; el dictador que jamás permitió que un solo niño cubano durmiera en la calle; el dictador de la educación universal y gratuita; el dictador que puso la sanidad —dentista incluido— al alcance de todos y sin coste alguno. Qué barbaridad, camaradas, cuánto daño le hizo Fidel al capitalismo.


Cero por ciento de analfabetismo. Cero desahucios. Cero desnutrición infantil. Un país sin fosas comunes ni cargas de antidisturbios contra su propio pueblo. Ese es el legado que Washington lleva más de sesenta años intentando estrangular, y que ahora, con Trump al frente, recrudece hasta el extremo de bloquear jeringuillas donadas por la solidaridad catalana y madrileña.


Porque no nos engañemos: Estados Unidos ha convertido su control sobre el sistema financiero global en un arma. Usa los mecanismos comerciales, las navieras, los seguros, la banca internacional, como instrumentos de sometimiento para quebrar lo que queda de …

author: Publicación Abierta
title: El pragmatismo económico prima sobre la ideología en la relación con China
content:
La relación entre Argentina, China y Estados Unidos continúa marcada por un delicado equilibrio entre las definiciones políticas y las necesidades económicas. El Gobierno de Javier Milei mantiene una postura pragmática frente a Beijing pese a sus diferencias ideológicas. Mientras, la embajada norteamericana advierte sobre “la amenaza china”.


Reunión bilateral entre el presidente chino, Xi Jinping y el presidente argentino, Javier Milei, al margen de la Cumbre de Líderes del G20, en Río de Janeiro, Brasil, el 19 de noviembre de 2024. (Xinhua/Zhang Ling)


Por Mario Hernandez


Las inversiones chinas, el swap de monedas y el financiamiento de obras de infraestructura convierten a China en un socio estratégico para la economía argentina. Un distanciamiento abrupto tendría consecuencias sobre proyectos considerados clave para el desarrollo del país.


El acuerdo comercial con Estados Unidos hoy tiene un alcance limitado y Washington concentra su interés en restringir el avance chino sobre sectores estratégicos argentinos. Lo que le importa a Estados Unidos del acuerdo comercial con la Argentina, son todos los cerrojos que le puso a China, especialmente en actividades vinculadas con la minería, la energía y el desarrollo tecnológico.


El volumen de capitales chinos en el país es de 23.000 millones de dólares de inversiones y lo más importante es que 10.600 millones son de financiamiento de infraestructura.


Además, si China retira su inversión en infraestructura, hay un montón de proyectos, las hidroeléctricas solo por nombrar uno, que quedarían parados.


Es un flujo de dólares que Argentina necesita para proyectos que son vitales y esa necesidad explica por qué el Gobierno mantiene una política exterior mucho más pragmática de lo que sugieren algunos de sus posicionamientos ideológicos.


El BCRA anunció la extensión de su acuerdo bilateral de intercambio de monedas (swap) con el Banco de la República Popular de China (PBoC)


Esta línea equivale a cerca de US$ 19.000 a 20.000 millones y sirve como respaldo para las reservas internacionales y el comercio bilateral.


Según la autoridad monetaria el nuevo entendimiento extiende el plazo de vigencia del acuerdo de tres a cinco años, una modificación que, de acuerdo con el organismo, permitirá “brindar una mayor previsibilidad sobre la continuidad de esta herramienta”.


La renovación mantiene vigente la activación del tramo del swap por 35.000 millones de yuanes, equivalentes a unos US$ 5.000 millones, que había sido acordada a comienzos de 2023. Según el BCRA, esos fondos continuarán disponibles como respaldo para la estabilidad financiera del país y como mecanismo de apoyo al comercio y la inversión bilateral entre Argentina y China.


La firma se concreta justo un día antes del vencimiento formal del contrato anterior, previsto para el jueves 6 de agosto, y llega tras semanas de negociaciones en las que el presidente del Banco Central, Santiago Bausili, había confirmado la intención de extender el mecanismo. “Estamos hablando con ellos igual que todas las últimas veces para extenderlo, no hay ningún plan de eliminarlo”, había dicho Bausili a mediados de año.


En su comunicado, el Banco Central menciona que “la renovación de estos acuerdos afianza la estrecha cooperación entre ambas instituciones y la excelente relación que han mantenido en los 17 años transcurridos desde el primer acuerdo firmado en 2009”.


El acuerdo tiene sus raíces en julio de 2009, cuando el entonces presidente del BCRA, Martín Redrado, y su par chino firmaron el primer contrato por RMB 70.000 millones (US$ 10.200 millones), en el contexto de la crisis financiera global. Ese primer swap venció sin ser activado. El monto total creció hasta los actuales RMB 130.000 millones tras la incorporación de un acuerdo suplementario por RMB 60.000 millones firmado en 2018, durante la presidencia de Mauricio Macri, que se sumó al contrato de RMB 70.000 millones renovado en 2017.


El tramo que permanece vigente se activó durante la gestión del ex presidente Alberto Fernández, cuando la falta de reservas internacionales llevó al BCRA a utilizar unos US$ 5.000 millones para el pago de importaciones desde China y para afrontar vencimientos con organismos internacionales. Al 14 de enero de 2026, el saldo remanente de ese tramo había descendido a US$ 679 millones, lo que implicó la devolución de casi el 90% de los fondos utilizados.

author: Daron Letts
title: Aluki Kotierk picked to lead Indigenous education advisory body
content:
Aluki Kotierk added another line to her growing resume this week when the National Advisory Committee on Indigenous Teacher Education named her a co-chair.


Kotierk served as a member of the forum’s 10-member committee since it was first established by the Rideau Hall Foundation in Janaury 2023. The foundation announced the appointment Tuesday.


“Kotierk leads by example,” the foundation website states. “(She is) driven by her passion to empower and improve the lives of Inuit.”


The other co-chair is Annette Trimbee, president of Grant MacEwan University, in Edmonton.


The committee is focused on increasing the numbers of Inuit, First Nations and Métis teachers in Canada.

The Rideau Hall Foundation is an independent and non-political charitable organization.


It has been a busy year for Kotierk.


In July, she was acclaimed to a four-year term as Inuit Circumpolar Council chairperson at the organization’s general assembly held in Iqluit.


Earlier in the spring, Kotierk was appointed chair of the United Nations’ Permanent Forum on Indigenous Issues. She presided over its 25th session in New York City in April.


In February 2025, then-Northern affairs minister Gary Anandasangaree appointed her as a special ministerial representative responsible for overseeing an external review of Nutrition North. In May, she delivered the report.


Kotierk served as the eighth president of Nunavut Tunngavik Inc., from late 2016 through 2024.


Before that she held leadership roles with the Government of Nunavut and worked with various Inuit organizations, including Pauktuutit Inuit Women of Canada, Inuit Tapirisat of Canada (now Inuit Tapiriit Kanatami) and Nunavut Sivuniksavut, an accredited, Inuit‑led post‑secondary school based in Ottawa.

author: Leanne Sanders
title: First Nation woman dies alongside two Correctional Service Canada officers during transport
content:
A collision near Provost, Alta., has claimed the lives of a Cree inmate and two officers with the

Correctional Service of Canada (CSC)

.


Grieving relatives have identified the woman as Kiara Dawn Mooswa, 25, a member of Poundmaker First Nation and the CSC confirmed her identity on its website.


On Friday afternoon, CSC also identified the Correctional Officers as Nicolae Serban, 57, of Sherwood Park, Alberta and Ramandeep Kaur Maan, 25, of Winnipeg as the officers from the Edmonton Institution for Women who died in the crash.


All three were confirmed deceased at the scene. The driver of the box truck was taken to a nearby hospital with minor injuries.


The two Correctional Service of Canada officers from the Edmonton Institution for Women have been identified as Nicolae Serban and Ramandeep Kaur Maan. Photo: Correctional Service of Canada


“On August 6, 2026, Kiara Mooswa, an inmate from Edmonton Institution for Women, died while in our custody. At the time of death, the inmate was 24 years old and had been serving a sentence of seven years and 20 days since April 11, 2024,” the CSC said.


A number of posts on social media reacted to her death.


“… been crying off and on all day. Life’s going to be so weird with out you. Going to miss our laughs and your phone calls,” wrote Shaay Moccasin.


According to RCMP, the collision took place northwest of Provost, a town near the Saskatchewan border about 285 km southeast of Edmonton Thursday morning at 11:22 a.m.


“Provost RCMP responded to a motor vehicle collision at the intersection of Highway 13 and Highway 41, along with Hughenden Fire Department and Wainwright RCMP. Upon arrival, it was determined that the collision was between a Hino Box Truck with a lone driver, and a Correctional Service Canada mini van occupied by two Correctional Officers and a female inmate,” a news release said.


The RCMP Collision Reconstructionist attended the scene and the cause of the collision remains under investigation.


A map showing the area where a Correctional Services Canada transport vehicle and Hino truck collided, killing a female inmate and two correctional services officers. Photo: APTN News


According to a source close to Mooswa’s family, she was being transported to the Healing Lodge in Maple Creek, Sask. at the time of the collision.


A Correctional Services Canada spokesperson declined to comment on the destination of the transport during an online media availability Friday afternoon.


Lawrence Hartigan, the acting regional deputy commissioner for the CSC said an ASIRT investigation of the circumstances will be part of the investigations going forward.


CSC is deeply saddened by the tragic loss of two officers and an offender in a tragic accident during a transfer from Edmonton Institution for Women. We extend our deepest condolences to the families, loved ones, friends and colleagues during this incredibly difficult time. (1/3)

pic.twitter.com/CZDBsPYs66


— Correctional Service (@CSC_SCC_en)

August 7, 2026


The acting district officer for the RCMP in eastern Alberta, James Morton said “we’ve gone the extra steps of reaching out to the families providing victim services support.”


A report by SaskToday.ca said Mooswa was serving a sentence for manslaughter in the death of another woman.


32-year-old Kaylee Crookedneck from Ministikwan Lake Cree Nation was killed on June 16, 2023 in North Battleford.


“The Alberta RCMP offers our sympathies to everyone affected by this tragic event.  We extend our support to our fellow officers at Correctional Service Canada as they mourn their friends and colleagues and send our condolences to the loved ones of all three individuals whose lives were lost yesterday,” said Wayne Nichols, the acting commanding officer of the Alberta RCMP.


The union representing the two correctional workers also issued a news release.


“At this time, the circumstances surrounding the incident remain under investigation by the RCMP,” said the release from the Union of Canadian Correctional Officers (UCCO-SACC-CSN). “Out of respect for that investigation and for the families involved, UCCO-SACC-CSN will not speculate on the events that led to this tragedy. We understand there are many questions, but it is essential that the investigative process be allowed to proceed without interference.”


Okimaw Ohci Healing Lodge, which may have been the destination of Mooswa’s transport, is located on the Nekaneet First Nation, near Maple Creek …

author: Monthly Review Press
title: New! Matthew Stanley’s “The Ragged Edge of Freedom”
content:
Against the Current

, by

Paul Buhle

:


“…Would-be farmers and merchants streamed in during the first half of the 19th century, often traversing westward and northward from the upper South, bringing along their genetic Anglo-Saxonism and their cultural politics. These regions carried subsurface coal waiting to be mined for the rising industrial machine….Political advocates of “free white labor” against potential competition of a geographically advancing slave system found their way into the Freesoil Party, a precursor to the Republicans. Democrats, for their part, believed that the safety of the Republic depended upon the defense of slavery in the South. Abolitionists and social reformers of all kinds, with a wide Yankee following augmented by many recent German immigrants, sought to take things beyond the uneasy accommodation of white populations to each other across existing political lines. In Wisconsin and in Chicago most notably, these would include “Abe’s Boys” enrolling in the army of the Union. Not so in the Southern Illinois, two hours’ drive from my hometown. The whites who immigrated northward from the near South, largely uneducated and lacking skills, came to be considered almost a species in themselves. Journalists at mid-century began to treat them with a relish shown a few decades earlier, in the popular press, about the ‘New Southwest’ created by the purchase of Louisiana…..”
